review_candidates.title: Linux System Engineer
review_candidates.description: Description The Defense Sector at Leidos is seeking a Linux System Engineer to support a fast-paced program with the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC). In this role, you will design, deploy, maintain, and optimize enterprise infrastructure supporting classified mission systems. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you'll help deliver reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure while supporting system deployments, lifecycle management, automation, and operational readiness. This position requires 100% on-site support in Oklahoma City, OK. Why This Role Matters Modern mission systems depend on resilient, well-engineered infrastructure. As mission requirements evolve, organizations face increasing complexity from system integration, infrastructure modernization, and the need to deliver capabilities efficiently without sacrificing reliability or security. As a Linux System Engineer, you'll help build and sustain the foundational platforms that enable mission success. You'll improve automation, standardization, and operational efficiency while delivering infrastructure that is reliable, scalable, and easier to deploy, manage, and maintain across enterprise environments. What You'll Bring You have experience supporting enterprise or classified infrastructure with a strong understanding of Windows and Linux systems, virtualization, enterprise core services, storage, networking, and systems integration. You are comfortable deploying, maintaining, and troubleshooting complex environments while improving automation, reliability, and operational efficiency. Most importantly, you're a self-starter who values accountability, continuous improvement, and technical excellence. You exercise sound judgment, work effectively with minimal oversight, and serve as a trusted engineering partner to both technical teams and leadership. If you're looking for an opportunity to modernize mission-critical infrastructure, influence technical direction, and make a measurable impact supporting national defense, we'd like to talk with you. Primary Responsibilities Install, configure, maintain, and patch physical and virtual Linux servers. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize system performance to ensure high availability, reliability, and operational readiness. Manage operating system updates, security hardening, and configuration changes in accordance with DoD policies and standards. Support system backups, disaster recovery, and data integrity to ensure business continuity. Administer system access, user accounts, and security configurations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support system deployments, software integration, and infrastructure modernization. Maintain accurate system documentation, configuration records, and operational procedures. Respond to and resolve infrastructure and system issues, including performance, availability, and security-related incidents. Promote knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and technical collaboration across the team. Basic Qualifications US Citizen with at least a Top Secret clearance and the ability to obtain a SCI prior to your start date Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of experience or Master’s degree with 2+ years of experience. Additional years of experience will be considered in lieu of a degree DoD 8140 Intermediate certification or DoD 8570 IAM Level II certification (or higher) Foundational experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure Experience administering Linux and Windows environments, including networking fundamentals and common protocols (HTTP, HTTPS, SSL/TLS, SMTP, DNS). Problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous or unstructured information. Self-starter that can work independently while possessing excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills. Preferred Qualifications US Citizen with an active TS/SCI security clearance Linux certifications (RHCSA, RHCE, CompTIA Linux+) Experience administering Red Hat Satellite Experience with virtualization platforms, including VMware ESXi and Microsoft Hyper-V Experience with enterprise infrastructure services, including PKI, certificate management, RSA Authentication Manager, RDS, and VDI Experience automating system administration using Ansible, including developing custom playbooks Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow and Jira Service Management DABAOPP1 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares. Original Posting September 17, 2026 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above. Pay Range Pay Range $87,100.00 - $157,450.00 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline onlyand not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. About Leidos Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com. Pay And Benefits Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits. Securing Your Data Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com. If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission. Commitment to Non-Discrimination All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.

review_candidates.title: NOC Engineer
review_candidates.description: Why join SUBCO We build the infrastructure the internet actually runs on. Most people don’t think about what happens when a video call connects Sydney to Singapore in under 100 milliseconds, or how a cloud file reaches a data centre on the other side of the world in the blink of an eye. The answer is almost always an undersea cable - and building those cables is exactly what SUBCO does. We build, own and operate high-capacity submarine cable systems linking Australia to Asia, the Middle East, and beyond. The internet’s backbone isn’t in the cloud. It’s on the ocean floor - and we put it there. You’ll work on things that matter at scale. SUBCO is an Australian-owned scaleup at an inflection point. We’re not a startup finding its feet, and we’re not a slow-moving incumbent. We’re a fast-growing team of specialists doing infrastructure work that shapes how entire regions connect to the global digital economy. About the role You will join a small, high-performing global team responsible for 24x7 monitoring, incident response, and operational support of SUBCO’s international optical and IP networks. Working within a rotating shift roster, you’ll monitor network performance, resolve incidents, manage stakeholder communications, automation and execute change activities to ensure service continuity across critical infrastructure. Responsibilities Proactively monitor all network infrastructure, including fibre systems, optical transmission, IP routers/switches, and environmental telemetry using tools like NCS, Observium, Environet and other tools like New Relic. Contribute to continual process improvement within the NOC by developing and implementing automations to reduce manual work, streamlining reporting, supporting enterprise-wide monitoring initiatives, and carrying out routine administration tasks Triage and resolve network events and incidents in accordance with SLAs, escalating appropriately via Jira Service Management. Maintain accurate and timely updates within incident and change tickets, including clear communication to internal stakeholders and external customers during outages or service degradations. Participate in the change management process, including peer review and execution of MOPs to support routine maintenance and network upgrades. Support continuous improvement by identifying incident trends, participating in post-incident reviews (PIRs), and helping evolve monitoring rules and automation alerts. Produce and maintain clear technical documentation, including runbooks, fault handling procedures, and change logs. Adhere to and contribute to operational KPIs such as Mean Time to Restore (MTTR), SLA compliance, and incident response targets. About You Proven experience operating in a 24x7 NOC or network support function Proven ability to apply automation and continuous improvement practices to enhance day-to-day operations. Comfortable working across vendor platforms including Cisco, Ciena, Nokia, and Fortinet (routers, switches, firewalls) Skilled in network performance troubleshooting and event triage within complex global network environments Familiarity with Data Centre environments including rack management, power, and thermal considerations Understanding of security compliance and physical access control processes within telecommunications facilities Hands-on experience with service management systems (Jira Service Management or similar) across incident, change, and problem management workflows Working knowledge of ITIL v3 or v4 principles including Service Operations and Service Transition Eligible to obtain Baseline Security Clearance (existing clearance is desirable) Competent in executing and reviewing Method of Procedures (MOPs) for planned work and changes Experience with monitoring, alerting, and observability platforms such as NCS, Observium, Environet and other tools like New Relic. Clear and calm communicator with the ability to effectively manage customer expectations and internal escalations under pressure Strong documentation habits, including incident summaries, PIRs, and shift handover reports Self-motivated team player, adaptable to shift-based work and remote collaboration with global colleagues Why you’ll love working at SUBCO Hybrid work model – We value face-to-face collaboration, while still giving you flexibility to balance work and life. We work in office together 3 days a week and 2 from home (Monday & Wednesdays). We work in a beautiful office, located in a convenient location in the Fortitude Valley. Flex Leave – 5 extra paid days each year for life admin, study, appointments, or the moments that matter most Your birthday off Free coffee & snacks Pet-friendly HQ – Bring your furry (or not-so-furry) friends to the office Parental leave – 12 weeks paid parental leave (or 24 weeks at half pay) with superannuation contributions for up to 12 months, even during unpaid leave Milestone rewards

Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future. Ensuring that all employees under their control are aware of their individual responsibilities, tasks, and targets for health and safety. Raising the efficiency of equipment to produce products with high quality. Managing the engineering and maintenance resource in support of plant safety, quality, cost, and efficiency goals. Increase the availability of machines with high performance. Support and participate actively as a UMS steering committee and support the factory improvements efforts. Assess the pending maintenance jobs, priorities, and plan for the maintenance technician. Advise the spare part requirements for the Engineering Stores. Undertake the Engineering improvements projects for the Factory. Decrease maintenance cost by: Studied modifications of weak points. Improved maintenance plan. Develop programs to improve technical skills, efficiency, and effectiveness in the Maintenance. Supervise and ensure that the maintenance team is performing by the required standards. Assess the technicians in the trouble shooting whenever necessary. Ensure CMMS is actively running, with high quality, and efficiency. Lead site’s process safety pillar to achieve all legal and company requirements. All About You Experiences & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering Mechanical Engineering, or Electromechanical Engineer, or Mechatronics Engineering educational background is a MUST. Suitable years of mechanical maintenance engineering experience in factories. Certificates in Process Safety / Sustainability is a plus. FMCG Experience is preferable. Skills Root Cause Analysis (RCA), People’s Management, Problem Solving, Decision Making, Team Collaboration, CMMS, SAP Leadership You are energized by delivering fantastic results. You are an example to others – both your results and your resilience. You are constantly on the lookout for better ways to do things, engaging and collaborating with others along the way. As an individual you are the one responsible for your own wellbeing and delivering high standards of work. You must also focus on the Consumer and what they need. PURPOSE & SERVICE: Has humility, understanding that leadership is service to others, inside and outside Unilever. review_candidates.title: Sales Representative
review_candidates.description: Company Description New Middle East Paints is a specialized manufacturer of protective and decorative coating systems serving a wide range of industrial and commercial clients. The company focuses on delivering high-quality solutions that meet demanding performance standards and evolving customer needs. Its portfolio includes epoxy, polyurethane, synthetic, acrylic, and advanced systems designed for severe conditions. In addition to products, New Middle East Paints provides comprehensive technical support to help clients select, apply, and maintain coating systems effectively. This combination of product range and service creates strong long-term partnerships with clients across the region. Role Description The Sales Representative is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt. This role is responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, managing existing customer accounts, and achieving sales targets for the company’s coating systems. Day-to-day activities include visiting clients, presenting product solutions, preparing sales proposals and quotations, and following up to close deals. The Sales Representative will collaborate with the technical team to provide product demonstrations and application guidance, and will gather market feedback to support continuous improvement. The role also involves maintaining accurate sales records, participating in industry events, and representing the company in a professional manner. Qualifications Demonstrated skills in B2B sales, customer relationship management, and account development. Experience in industrial or construction-related sales, preferably in paints, coatings, or building materials. Ability to understand technical product features and translate them into clear value propositions for clients. Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Proficiency in basic business tools (e.g., CRM systems, MS Office) and report preparation. Proactive approach to prospecting, lead generation, and achieving defined sales targets. Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel within Cairo and surrounding regions for client visits. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Fluency in Arabic and good command of English for business communication. Ability to work collaboratively with technical and operations teams and maintain a client-focused mindset.
